definitions.gloss: deep bass; heavy bass sound; low-frequency sound
definitions.explanation: A deep, resonant low-frequency sound that can often be felt physically as vibration. Commonly used when describing audio equipment, music, engines, or natural phenomena like thunder.

examples.japanese: {重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スピーカー→スピーカー：04420_supiikaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。

⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}わって→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧きて、⟦{鳥肌|とりはだ}→鳥肌：08544_torihada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: At the concert venue, the deep bass traveled through my body and gave me goosebumps.

notes:
Composed of {重|じゅう} (heavy, deep) + ⟦{低音|ていおん}→低音：18282_teion⟧ (low sound, bass). This word emphasizes the physicality and weight of deep bass frequencies — not just low pitch but the kind of resonant, chest-thumping sound you can feel in your body.

Frequently used in product descriptions for audio equipment (headphones, speakers, subwoofers) and in music discussions, especially for genres like hip-hop, EDM, and club music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: deep bass reverberates
- {重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧: bass reproduction (audio spec)
- {重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧: bass-heavy model (headphones, speakers)
- {重低音|じゅうていおん}⟦スピーカー→スピーカー：04420_supiikaa⟧: bass speaker, subwoofer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低音|ていおん}→低音：18282_teion⟧: bass, low sound — more neutral, just refers to low pitch
- {低音域|ていおんいき}: low frequency range — technical audio term
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧: bass — English loanword used in music
